headline: NFL Week 6: Chiefs beat the Chargers 22-6 and stay 5-0
whyCareReason: Kansas City stays perfect. The Chargers fall to 0-6. ESPN lists the final as 22-6, not 27-20.
teaser: Arrowhead finished Chargers 6, Chiefs 22. Mahomes threw for 272 yards. Kenneth Walker III rushed for 128.
story: ESPN's Week 6 scoreboard lists the Los Angeles Chargers 6, Kansas City Chiefs 22 at GEHA Field at Arrowhead Stadium. Quarters: Chargers 3, 0, 3, 0 and Chiefs 9, 10, 0, 3. ESPN lists Patrick Mahomes with 272 passing yards, Kenneth Walker III with 128 rushing yards and Xavier Worthy with 73 receiving yards. The Chiefs are 5-0. The Chargers are 0-6. An earlier 27-20 line, with invented fourth-quarter touchdowns, is withdrawn.
stakes: Kansas City stays one of three unbeaten teams, with the Vikings (on a bye) and the 49ers. The Chargers are 0-6.
rivalryAngle: An AFC West game that finished 22-6, not a one-score finish.
